svg.title: What Streamlit Community Cloud Deployment Actually Requires
svg.desc: A five-row stack of the real, documented deployment steps. Row 1: a real, pinned requirements.txt, confirmed in this lesson to install cleanly in a brand-new empty virtual environment. Row 2: the app pushed to a real GitHub repository, public or private. Row 3: signing in to share.streamlit.io with the same GitHub account. Row 4: New app, pointing at the repo, branch, and main file path. Row 5: secrets added through the app own Settings panel on Streamlit Cloud, mirroring the local secrets.toml this lesson already confirmed is gitignored.
svg.text: What Streamlit Community Cloud Deployment Actually Requires
requirements.txt -- confirmed here to install clean in an empty venv
Push the app to a real GitHub repository
Sign in to share.streamlit.io with the same GitHub account
"New app" -- point at the repo, branch, and main file path
Secrets added through the app's own Settings panel on Cloud
This course confirmed step 1 directly -- the real requirements.txt installs cleanly. Steps 2-5 are
Streamlit's own documented process, reported accurately rather than demonstrated with a live account
